title: Guy Manages to Escape Police Three Times in 8 Days
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

Within an eight-day period, a man was able to escape the police three times. On October 15, 2022, officers observed a male with a suspended driver’s license operating a vehicle in La Crosse, WI. When a traffic stop was conducted, he fled at a high rate of speed. A few days later, he was found again and fled, ignoring any commands. Another couple of days passed and he was discovered while police were responding to trouble with a party call. Officers approached him and he led them on another pursuit. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
